TITLE: Set up the Platform Console
DESCRIPTION: Create the first Instance Owner account for this Arclayer deployment.
CREATE_OWNER_DESCRIPTION: This is the only owner for the deployment. You can't assign ownership through a regular platform role.
ACCOUNT_NAME_DESCRIPTION: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.
PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION: Use 8–128 characters with at least one letter and one number.
COMPLETE_DESCRIPTION: {{owner}} is now the Instance Owner for this deployment.
SECURITY_SETUP_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION: Sign in with this account, then add and verify a security key or passkey. You can't enter the Platform Console until this is complete.
REPAIR_DESCRIPTION: Existing setup records do not confirm a safe, complete Instance Owner state. Repair the deployment setup before continuing.
REPAIR_INVALID_INSTALL_RECORD_TITLE: The installation record cannot be verified
REPAIR_INVALID_INSTALL_RECORD_DESCRIPTIO: Ask the deployment administrator to inspect and repair the installation record. The Console won't replace or ignore it.
REPAIR_STATE_MISMATCH_TITLE: Owner and installation records don't match
REPAIR_STATE_MISMATCH_DESCRIPTION: Ask the deployment administrator to compare the Instance Owner and installation records, then repair the mismatch before continuing.
REPAIR_UNKNOWN_DESCRIPTION: Ask the deployment administrator to inspect the setup records. The Console can't tell which record is valid.
